result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, with one clear text error and minor clipping issues in horizontally scrollable content.

issues.suggestion: Change the placeholder to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries.”

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant in the “Fastest near you” carousel has its name and delivery information abruptly cut off at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Constrain text to the card width with ellipsis and add sufficient trailing carousel padding so partially visible cards do not show overflowing text.

issues.description: The category carousel ends with a largely blank, partially visible pill at the right edge, which looks like a clipped or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure every partially visible chip contains visible text, or adjust item widths and right padding so the next chip is presented more clearly.
